name: kanka-mcp
description: Manage Kanka campaigns, characters, locations, posts, relations, and full-text search from any MCP client.
long_description: MCP server for the Kanka worldbuilding API. 15 tools spanning auth, campaigns, search (native name + client-side full-text), and full CRUD on all 18 entity types. Includes a token-bucket rate limiter that auto-tunes from /profile, OAuth 2.0 + PKCE with refresh, structured 422 validation errors, and dual-ID resolution.

kanka_token.title: Personal API Token (recommended)
kanka_token.description: Get one at https://app.kanka.io/settings/api. Leave blank if you intend to use OAuth instead.

oauth_client_id.title: OAuth Client ID (advanced, optional)
oauth_client_id.description: If using OAuth: register a client at https://app.kanka.io/settings/api?clients=1 with redirect URI http://localhost:53117/cb. Then call kanka_oauth_login from your MCP client.

oauth_client_secret.title: OAuth Client Secret (advanced, optional)
oauth_client_secret.description: Pairs with the OAuth Client ID above. Leave blank if using a Personal Token.

oauth_redirect_port.title: OAuth Redirect Port (advanced, optional)
oauth_redirect_port.description: Defaults to 53117. Must match the port in your registered redirect URI.

rate_limit_override.title: Rate Limit Override (rpm, advanced, optional)
rate_limit_override.description: Override the auto-tuned rate limit. Leave blank to let the server detect free/subscriber via /profile (30/90 rpm).

log_level.title: Log Level (optional)
log_level.description: trace, debug, info, warn, error, or fatal. Defaults to info.

tools.name: kanka_auth_status
tools.description: Check whether a Kanka credential is configured

tools.name: kanka_oauth_login
tools.description: Run OAuth Authorization Code + PKCE login

tools.name: kanka_list_campaigns

tools.name: kanka_describe_entity_type

tools.name: kanka_search

tools.name: kanka_full_text_search

tools.name: kanka_get_entity
